business.body:
- Sixth-largest pharmaceutical company in India by value (IQVIA SSA MAT Mar'26) and #3 by prescriptions (SMSRC MAT Feb'26), with 50+ years of legacy and a dominant position in anti-infectives, gastrointestinal disorders, pain management and supplements.
- #1 IPM rank in Anti-Infectives sustained for 15+ years; top-3 player in 4 of the top 7 largest IPM therapy areas; expanding presence in chronic therapies (diabetes, neurology, dermatology, urology).
- PAN is the biggest brand family in the IPM and ranks #2 in the IPM Top 300; the company has built 36 brand families worth over Rs.500 Mn each, including 1 family above Rs.10 Bn and 5 above Rs.5 Bn.
- Leading player in the Trade Generics segment; international presence spans the US, Latin America, Australia, Europe and other Asian markets.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Acquisitions] Grew inorganically through Pharmacor Pty Ltd (Australia, 2009), Enzene Biosciences (biosimilars, 2011), the Advita Ortho (erstwhile Exactech) licensing agreement (MedTech entry, FY25), and the Adroit & Bombay Ortho acquisition (FY26).
- [Index Inclusion] Alkem was included in the MSCI India Index during FY25.

deepdive.thesis: Alkem Laboratories reported strong Q4FY26 results with 14.6% YoY revenue growth and 32.2% YoY EBITDA growth, driven by robust performance in India branded generics and international businesses, despite cost pressures and geopolitical uncertainties.

drhp.business: Alkem is a Mumbai-headquartered diversified healthcare company built on a domestic branded and trade-generics prescription pharma franchise (housed under wholly-owned subsidiary Alkem Wellness), leading in acute and chronic therapies such as anti-infectives, vitamins and nutrients, pain management and gastro-intestinal, with growing presence in anti-diabetics, dermatology, urology, ophthalmology and respiratory care. Its international business spans regulated and emerging markets across the United States, Europe, Australia, Latin America, CIS, the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia …

drhp.expansion: FY26 capital deployment centred on three new growth platforms rather than core-plant capacity addition.
